sources.snippet: Prepare and build the ChemProp model. Downloads and loads the CheMeleon foundation model if specified, otherwise constructs a new MPNN model with the given configuration.

sources.title: ChemProp - ADMET Workbench
sources.snippet: OpenADMET Challenge ChemProp models were used by many top performers on the OpenADMET Leaderboard. Workbench supports all four ChemProp model types with the same simple API.

sources.snippet: Welcome to Chemprop's documentation! # This website contains documentation for Chemprop, a PyTorch-based framework for training and evaluating message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) for molecular property prediction.
